name: train
description: An electric railcar with a cab at each end: a body lofted from its side silhouette with streamlined noses, raked windscreens, a rounded roof with cooling units and a pantograph, tinted window panes, livery stripes and two double sliding doors per side; underfloor equipment, and two bogies with springs, dampers and axle boxes that turn about their centre, carrying flanged wheels on standard gauge (1.435 m) with the pivot at the hub.
